name: Giorgio Scarlatti
bio: A Roman who bought his way into the sport and then justified it. His Maserati A6GCS retired from the 1955 Mille Miglia; three years later he was second at the Targa Florio with Jean Behra, and in 1961 he won the Pescara four hours with Lorenzo Bandini in a 250 Testa Rossa. Fifteen Grand Prix entries between 1956 and 1961 brought a single point, for fifth at Monza in 1957 in a car shared with Harry Schell.
